metadata.description: A Claude Code marketplace shipping the janitor plugin: two skills for cleaning up slow machines (macOS and Windows) and messy Claude Code working directories. Reversible, permission-gated, no telemetry.

plugins.name: janitor
plugins.description: Two slash-command skills: janitor-device diagnoses and cleans up slow macOS or Windows machines, and janitor-claude audits and tidies the current Claude Code working directory. Read-only by default, every mutation requires explicit confirmation, no silent sudo, no git mutations, no telemetry.
